lh: LH is a gonadotropic hormone that is secreted by the anterior pituitary.
LH means the same as luteinizing hormone or interstitial cell-stimulating hormone or ICSH.
lhasa: Lhasa is the sacred city of Lamaism.
Lhasa can also mean a breed of terrier having a long heavy coat raised in Tibet as watchdogs.
Lhasa means the same as Lassa or capital of Tibet or Forbidden City.
lhasa apso: Lhasa apso is a breed of terrier having a long heavy coat raised in Tibet as watchdogs.
Lhasa apso means the same as Lhasa.
lhotse: Lhotse is a mountain in the central Himalayas on the border of Tibet and Nepal.
